description: Schemas bundled with fair-bioheaders, by FHR-Specification release (docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md in FHR-Specification). 'current' are the copies of FHR-Specification main that raw-main URLs select, and 'release' names the release they belong to (null when main is ahead of every release). Each release entry points at a frozen copy of that release's schema. 'drafts' are unaccepted development contracts from the type repositories; they are never selected unless draft support is explicitly enabled, carry no release tag and no w3id alias, and are not part of the SCHEMA-VERSIONS rules V1-V6 (see docs/FHT-SELECTION-DESIGN.md).

FHT.source: FHT-Specification (development repository; no released contract, no w3id alias, not in schemas/versions.json)
